DigitalPlatforms.hero_desc: Developing and deploying digital solutions that bridge information gaps, enhance seed authentication, and connect stakeholders across the agricultural ecosystem.
DigitalPlatforms.oa_desc: Our approach combines deep agricultural domain expertise with modern software development practices to create platforms that actually work in the field.
DigitalPlatforms.sp_desc: Developed in partnership with KALRO, KEPHIS, with support from Kenya Markets Trust/Gatsby Africa, MbeguChoice helps farmers and agrodealers identify the right seed varieties for their specific ecological zones, taking the guesswork out of planting.
DigitalPlatforms.cta_desc: Whether you need a national variety catalogue, a seed verification system, or custom data analytics, we have the expertise to build and deploy solutions that scale.

platforms.title: Africa Digital Crop Variety Catalogue
platforms.description: An online, searchable platform that consolidates officially released and registered crop varieties from multiple African countries into a single database.

platforms.title: Kenya Plant Variety List
platforms.description: An online, searchable platform containing all officially released and registered crop varieties in Kenya, featuring both public access for general information and restricted access for proprietary information.

platforms.title: Tanzania Agri-Inputs Platform
platforms.description: An online interactive and searchable database of industry stakeholders, varieties released in Tanzania, registered agrochemicals, and agrodealers mapped to their locations.

platforms.title: MbeguChoice
platforms.description: A farmer-centric digital platform with an offline-capable mobile app that catalogues commercialized crop varieties in Kenya. It provides detailed information on disease resistance, maturity periods, agroecological suitability, and other key varietal characteristics. The platform empowers farmers, extension workers, and agrodealers to make informed variety selection decisions that enhance productivity, resilience, and performance.

platforms.title: Seed Sector Platform Kenya
platforms.description: An online interactive and searchable database of industry stakeholders, varieties released in Kenya, and agrodealers mapped to their locations.

platforms.title: Agricultural Inputs Platform Uganda
platforms.description: An online interactive and searchable database of industry stakeholders, varieties released in Uganda, registered agrochemicals, and agrodealers mapped to their locations.

platforms.title: Mulika Mbegu Mbovu (M3)
platforms.description: An SMS-based feedback mechanism for farmers to report low-quality and fake seeds to KEPHIS, helping to combat fake and counterfeit seeds in the Kenyan market.

approach.title: Assess & Design
approach.description: Understand stakeholder needs through deep consultation and design intuitive digital interfaces that solve real problems in the agricultural value chain.

approach.title: Build & Integrate
approach.description: Develop scalable, robust platforms connected to existing agricultural systems — ensuring interoperability and seamless data flow across institutions.

approach.title: Deploy & Support
approach.description: Launch solutions with comprehensive training and ongoing technical support, ensuring adoption and long-term sustainability across stakeholder groups.

DigitalPlatforms.sp_desc2: MbeguChoice represents the future of agricultural decision support — a digital platform that puts critical variety information directly in the hands of those who need it most.

ProjectImplementation.hero_subtitle: Turning Agricultural Strategy into Field Reality
ProjectImplementation.hero_desc1: Bridging the gap between agricultural strategy and field-level execution. Agri Experience executes complex, multi-stakeholder programs that deliver tangible and sustainable results on the ground, benefiting permanent actors and farmers.
ProjectImplementation.hero_desc2: Our implementation practice combines deep technical expertise with rigorous project management to execute seed sector interventions, agrodealer capacity programs, and technology deployments across Sub-Saharan Africa.
ProjectImplementation.pm_desc: We treat implementation as a discipline. Every project is guided by structured methodologies to ensure on-time delivery, stakeholder alignment, and verifiable impact.
ProjectImplementation.pm_step1_desc: We quickly move from concept to detailed operational planning. This includes mobilizing teams, defining clear KPIs, establishing reporting structures, and aligning all stakeholders around shared objectives.
ProjectImplementation.pm_step2_desc: Field realities often diverge from boardroom plans. We utilize agile management principles, allowing us to pivot strategies based on real-time feedback from the ground while maintaining focus on the ultimate goals.
ProjectImplementation.pm_step3_desc: Implementation is meaningless without measurement. We embed M&E into our daily operations, utilizing digital tools to track progress, ensure quality assurance, and provide transparent reporting to partners.
ProjectImplementation.pm_step4_desc: We don't just execute; we build local capability. Our projects are designed to transfer knowledge and operational skills to local institutions, ensuring that impact sustains long after our direct involvement ends.
ProjectImplementation.cs_desc: A comprehensive initiative to strengthen the last-mile delivery of improved crop varieties to smallholder farmers through agrodealer capacity building and establishing strategic linkages.
ProjectImplementation.cta_desc: Whether you need to manage a national agricultural survey, deploy a digital platform, or coordinate a multi-county training program, our team has the proven capability to deliver.

StakeholderConvenings.hero_subtitle: Bringing the Seed-focused, Agricultural Ecosystem Together
StakeholderConvenings.hero_desc1: Complex agricultural challenges require coordinated action. Agri Experience designs, facilitates, and manages convenings that turn disparate stakeholders into aligned partnerships focusing on a common goal.
StakeholderConvenings.hero_desc2: From high-level policy roundtables to cross-border learning trips, Agri Experience provides the logistical precision and sector knowledge needed to make every convening impactful.
StakeholderConvenings.wcm_desc: We don't just organize meetings; we orchestrate outcomes. Strategic convenings are catalysts for agricultural transformation.
StakeholderConvenings.pm_step1_desc: We don't do generic agendas. Every convening is designed around specific policy or operational objectives.
StakeholderConvenings.pm_step2_desc: Our team's deep sector knowledge ensures that conversations stay focused, technical, and productive.
StakeholderConvenings.pm_step3_desc: From complex visa arrangements for regional trips to on-the-ground event management, we handle all details.
StakeholderConvenings.pm_step4_desc: We provide comprehensive documentation and track post-event commitments to ensure momentum isn't lost.
StakeholderConvenings.cs_subtitle: In partnership with Kenya Markets Trust
StakeholderConvenings.cs_desc1: Agri Experience facilitated a crucial series of roundtables that brought together private seed companies, regulatory bodies, and development partners to address systemic bottlenecks in Kenya's seed sector.
StakeholderConvenings.cs_desc2: These convenings were instrumental in building consensus around policy reforms, harmonizing standards, and fostering a more collaborative relationship between the public and private sectors.
StakeholderConvenings.cta_desc: Whether you're planning a multi-country learning journey, a technical workshop, or a high-level policy dialogue, our team has the expertise to make it a success.

StakeholderConvenings.callout_text: From Nairobi to Accra, Lusaka to Lagos — we bring stakeholders together where it matters most.
StakeholderConvenings.sp_subtitle: In partnership with Kenya Markets Trust
StakeholderConvenings.sp_desc1: Agri Experience facilitated a crucial series of roundtables that brought together private seed companies, regulatory bodies, and development partners to address systemic bottlenecks in Kenya’s seed sector.
StakeholderConvenings.sp_desc2: These convenings were instrumental in building consensus around policy reforms, harmonizing standards, and fostering a more collaborative relationship between the public and private sectors. As a result, the Seeds Regulations were revised and gazetted in 2016, allowing for an increased private sector enabling environment.

TechnicalStudies.hero_subtitle: Data-Driven Insights for the Seed Sector
TechnicalStudies.hero_desc1: At Agri Experience, we believe that effective strategy begins with accurate, field-tested data.
TechnicalStudies.hero_desc2: We conduct rigorous technical studies and scoping exercises that provide development partners, governments, and private sector players with the evidence base needed to design impactful interventions and policies.
TechnicalStudies.cs_desc1: Commissioned by RTI International under the USAID Kenya Crops and Dairy Market Systems (KCDMS) Activity, Agri Experience executed a comprehensive mapping of agrodealers across 12 counties, with geolocation and contact information.
TechnicalStudies.cs_desc2: Agri Experience mapped existing agrodealer networks, assessed gaps in last-mile delivery, and provided actionable recommendations to strengthen input distribution systems for smallholder farmers.
TechnicalStudies.cta_desc: Whether you need a comprehensive sector assessment or a targeted feasibility study, our research teams are ready to deploy.

studyTypes.title: Market & Sector Assessments
studyTypes.description: Comprehensive surveys of market participants — farmers, seed producers, agrodealers, and regulators — delivering industry landscape analysis and competitive positioning.

studyTypes.title: Scoping Studies
studyTypes.description: Field-based analysis for seed and input sector assessments, identifying opportunities, challenges, and intervention points across value chains.

studyTypes.title: Crop Value Chain Analysis

studyTypes.title: Industry Benchmarking
studyTypes.description: Development of industry benchmarking tools, performance metrics, and comparative analysis — setting standards for seed sector development.

studyTypes.title: Policy & Regulatory Analysis
studyTypes.description: Analysis of seed policy frameworks and regulations, comparison with global best practices, and recommendations for regulatory reform and harmonization.

studyTypes.title: Feasibility Studies
studyTypes.description: Assessing viability of new programs, platforms, and interventions through risk assessment, mitigation strategies, and cost-benefit analysis for agricultural investments.
